scope: Read-only v1.10 development frames. Do not modify the controller or its endpoint/sweep definition.
hypothesis: Back-project each accepted coded-boundary adjacency at its subpixel midpoint, using a same-frame local depth plane rather than the global sheet plane. Fit inverse depth from same-colour sheet pixels within 5 pixels on each labelled side. Require at least 4 non-collinear samples, a finite positive intersection, <=2 mm fit residual (90th percentile), and <=2 mm disagreement across an internal transition. Do not silently discard an observed bank vote if its local fit fails. Keep bank membership, skew, row order, missing-row and physical sweep rules. Compute the material coordinate of the existing direct slit estimate independently from current tissue depth at its projected apex. Never use nodes to estimate a boundary or apex.
test: Frozen checkpoints v1.10 nominal tick 26, noise tick 34, withdrawn truth ticks 16 and 17. Also evaluate every direct mapped pre-endpoint observation from the same captures. Report unresolved measurements, physical bank spreads, and normal/guard knot errors. A candidate is not suitable for live control unless BOTH withdrawn endpoints map into [9,10] mm, both 5 mm checkpoints are within 1 mm, and no pre-endpoint observation reaches the stop threshold. Do not select a method using holdouts.
